reviews.text: From the very first consultation, Dr. Bruno and Bruna demonstrated exemplary professionalism and great care for our cats. The space is clean, modern, and welcoming. The veterinarian explained the entire diagnosis clearly and patiently, giving us a great sense of security. Without a doubt, we have found the right clinic for our furry friends.
Fantastic, excellent professionals who make you feel very welcome.

I would like to express my huge gratitude to Dr. Bruno for his professionalism and kind attitude towards animals!

We have tried many clinics before, but it is with you that both we and our cats truly feel calm and safe.

Thank you for your care, patience, and genuine love for animals!

I took my dog ​​to the Lumiar Veterinary Clinic for his first check-up and mandatory vaccinations, and the experience was excellent.

From the moment I walked in, the reception team was super friendly and attentive, which immediately put us at ease. The veterinarian explained everything very clearly, showed genuine care for my dog, and was extremely professional.

We felt very well taken care of throughout the entire process. It gives us a lot of confidence knowing that our pet is in good hands. I recommend them without any hesitation. 🐶💙

Thank you so much to Dr. Bruno for the excellent service ❤️
Our kitten Mia's sterilization went very well.
When an unforeseen event occurred, we were received without an appointment and with great attention.
Professional, calm and very careful. I sincerely recommend him ❤️
